collection.title: Vauxhall Grandland X 2017 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Vauxhall Grandland X 2017 - 2024 which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Grandland X which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
